description: Build a swap for the user to sign. Does not broadcast. Requires the "swap" permission. Native coin, cross-chain (buyChainId) and gasless (typed-data payloads instead of calldata) are all supported. Give the user reviewUrl: it opens the app with this exact trade filled in, ready to sign. If hands-free trading is on, use execute_swap instead. On Solana it is quoted for the user’s own Solana wallet and signed in the app.
name: prepare_swap
title: Prepare a swap
